core.title: 1.5 Inch Diameter Stainless Door Pull, First Impressions DSS-BSS-1.5x40

text.description_html:
First Impressions DSS-BSS-1.5 Modern Stainless Steel Door Pull

Elegance from the clean design lines makes this pull a very popular choice when dressing up your door. 1.5" diameter x 40" tall stainless steel door handles with a soft Satin Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications for First Impressions DSS-BSS-1.5 1.5" Diameter x 40" Tall Stainless Steel Pull

  • Pull Diameter: 1.5"
  • Pull Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Pull Length: 40"
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Note: This pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 7 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the pull, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts through the door). Optional Surface mounting (Bolts to door face) or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually.
